verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh man paragaas hai piram piaalaa ajar jara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The enlightened mind of the Sikhs drinks and digests the unbearable cup of the love of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham braham bibekee dhiaan dhara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Armed with the knowledge of the Brahm, they meditate upon the transcendental Brahm.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣ ਹੋਇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen hoi akath kathaa gur sabadh suna(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Merging their consciousness in the Word-shabad, they recite the indescribable story of the Word-the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖਹੁਂ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਖੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: bhoot bhavikhahu(n) varatamaan abigat gat at alakh lakha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: They are competent to see incomprehensible pace of the past, present and future.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal achhal chhal bhagat vachhal kar achhal chhala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Never deluding fruit of joy, the gurmukhs get, and with grace of the  God, kind to devotees, they rather delude the evil propensities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਇਕਸ ਪਿਛੇ ਲਖ ਤਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: bhavajal a(n)dhar bohithai ikas pichhe lakh tara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: They work as a boat in the world-ocean and ferry across the millions who follow one gurmukh, the Guru-oriented person.
The altruist Sikhs always come up smiling.
